observedArchitecturalFeatures.overallSilhouette: Two-story Nordic medieval timber-and-stone guildhall with steep front-facing gable, side cross-gable wing, and stone chimney stack on East side
observedArchitecturalFeatures.roofGeometry: 45-degree (1:1) pitched dark-wood gable roof with stepped stone-brick rake overhangs, upside-down soffit stairs, side cross-gable, and smoking masonry chimney
observedArchitecturalFeatures.entrance: Recessed central double oak doorway framed by arched timber/stone trim, flanked by hanging lanterns, approached via wide stone-brick steps
observedArchitecturalFeatures.balcony: Recessed second-story central loggia/balcony above main entrance with dark spruce fence balustrade and hanging lanterns
observedArchitecturalFeatures.windows: Recessed paned windows on ground stone wall, upper cream plaster bays, and central attic gable, each framed by dark spruce shutters
observedArchitecturalFeatures.pillarsAndBeams: Full-height vertical dark spruce log columns on corners and bay divisions tied by horizontal spruce crossbeams and corbels
observedArchitecturalFeatures.decorativeDetails: Blue hanging guild banners on corner timber brackets, smoking chimney, warm lantern illumination
observedArchitecturalFeatures.landscaping: Stone-brick front courtyard plaza and perimeter path, geometric 2-block-high oak-leaf hedges, and 4 symmetrical courtyard lantern posts

structuralWidthX.basis: 3 symmetric front bays + corner/bay pillars + odd-center gable apex

wallThickness.basis: Proud outer spruce columns + recessed infill walls & shutters
